architecture_selection.evidence: The discriminative event stage (RD1 detector family + event-raster conditioning) adopted by BF0 and inherited unchanged by C0, C0-A, E0, R1, SF0, AF0 and DP0 was motivated with V1 TEST numbers (504395d design document). No DP0 sharing pattern, width or adapter was selected on TEST (DP-DEV / AF-LOCK only).

threshold_tuning.evidence: threshold 0.35 / refractory 32 come from the R1 rhythm-observability probe (71aefb4, 2026-09-02, before VitalDB entered the project on 2026-09-17). The detector with this exact convention was, however, evaluated on V1 TEST (RD1, 02628f3), which is SF0 rule (a).

checkpoint_selection.evidence: BF0 ... DP0 used last-step checkpoints only.

loss_design.evidence: DP0 uses L1 and the SF0 flow-matching MSE; LW1 (f777a16) evaluated auxiliary endpoint losses on V1 TEST, none of which DP0 uses.

metric_selection.evidence: The metric suite predates the VitalDB V1 split; FBC1 (c9c2004) selected against cells derived from legacy-test patients, not used by DP0.

sf0_rule_a.evidence: RD1 detector (RhythmTCN, 328,897 parameters, Gaussian sigma 20 ms targets, threshold 0.35, refractory 32) evaluated on V1 TEST (02628f3); DP0 / DP1 reuse exactly this detector family and convention (artifacts/dp0_dualreadout/detector_config.json).

sf0_rule_b.evidence: docs/BEAT_FIRST_ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_KO.md (504395d) cites V1 TEST numbers as the basis for the discriminative event stage; DP0 descends from that closed chain (BF0 -> C0 -> C0-A -> R1 -> SF0 -> AF0 -> DP0).
